title: Asana OAuth setup + fetch scripts for firewall-dashboard
spec:
## Context
The firewall-dashboard (tools/firewall-dashboard/) is a Vite/React app that reads `/data/tasks.json`
at runtime. `package.json` already has `"fetch": "node scripts/fetch-asana.js"` but the script
doesn't exist yet. The `.env.example` uses `ASANA_PAT` which Cisco blocks. We need OAuth instead.
The user has ASANA_CLIENT_ID and ASANA_CLIENT_SECRET ready to add to `.env`.

ASANA_PROJECT_GID is already known: `1213865344385089` (keep this as the default in .env.example)

## Files to create / modify

### 1. scripts/asana-oauth-setup.js  (CREATE — does NOT exist)
One-time OAuth setup script for local use. Node.js, no external deps beyond `dotenv`.

Flow:
- Read ASANA_CLIENT_ID, ASANA_CLIENT_SECRET, ASANA_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI from `.env`
- If CLIENT_ID or SECRET missing → print instructions and exit 1
- Start a local HTTP server on ASANA_REVIEW_PORT (default 8845)
- Listen for GET /callback?code=...&state=...
  - Validate state matches what we generated
  - POST to https://app.asana.com/-/oauth_token with grant_type=authorization_code
  - Parse response → extract access_token, refresh_token, expires_in
  - Update .env in-place (upsert ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN, ASANA_REFRESH_TOKEN, ASANA_TOKEN_EXPIRES_AT)
  - Print tokens summary to terminal (do NOT expose raw tokens in clear text — just print "saved to .env")
  - Close server and exit 0
- Open browser to Asana authorize URL:
  https://app.asana.com/-/oauth_authorize?client_id=...&redirect_uri=...&response_type=code&state=<random>

State must be a random hex string (use crypto.randomBytes). Validate it on callback to prevent CSRF.

### 2. scripts/fetch-asana.js  (CREATE — does NOT exist)
Data fetch script. Node.js, no external deps beyond `dotenv`.

Flow:
- Read ASANA_CLIENT_ID, ASANA_CLIENT_SECRET, ASANA_REFRESH_TOKEN, ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN,
  ASANA_TOKEN_EXPIRES_AT, ASANA_PROJECT_GID from `.env`
- If both CLIENT_ID+SECRET and REFRESH_TOKEN present:
  - Check if access token is still valid (ASANA_TOKEN_EXPIRES_AT > now + 120s)
  - If not, POST to https://app.asana.com/-/oauth_token with grant_type=refresh_token
  - Update .env with new access_token and expires_at
- Else if ACCESS_TOKEN present: use it directly (fallback)
- Else: error "Run `npm run setup-oauth` first"
- GET https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/projects/{ASANA_PROJECT_GID}/tasks
  with opt_fields: gid,name,assignee.name,due_on,completed,memberships.section.name,custom_fields
- Map each task to FirewallTask shape:
  {
    gid: string,
    name: string,
    section: string,       // from memberships[0].section.name, default ""
    assignee: string,      // from assignee.name, default "Unassigned"
    status: string,        // derive from custom_fields "Status" field if present, else "In Progress"/"Done"
    due_on: string | null,
    completed: boolean
  }
- Write output to public/data/tasks.json (create public/data/ if needed)
- Print count of tasks written

### 3. .env.example  (MODIFY)
Replace:
  ASANA_PAT=your_asana_personal_access_token_here

With:
  # Asana OAuth (PATs are blocked on Cisco networks — use OAuth instead)
  # 1. Add client ID + secret from Asana Developer Console
  # 2. Register redirect URI: http://127.0.0.1:8845/oauth/callback
  # 3. Run: npm run setup-oauth
  ASANA_CLIENT_ID=
  ASANA_CLIENT_SECRET=
  ASANA_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI=http://127.0.0.1:8845/oauth/callback
  ASANA_REVIEW_PORT=8845
  # Populated automatically by setup-oauth:
  ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN=
  ASANA_REFRESH_TOKEN=
  ASANA_TOKEN_EXPIRES_AT=
  ASANA_PROJECT_GID=1213865344385089

### 4. package.json  (MODIFY)
Add `"setup-oauth": "node scripts/asana-oauth-setup.js"` to scripts.
Keep existing `"fetch": "node scripts/fetch-asana.js"`.

## Security rules
- NEVER log or print raw token values — only print "✅ Tokens saved to .env"
- .env must remain gitignored (already is)
- State parameter must be validated on callback (CSRF protection)

## Working directory
tools/firewall-dashboard/

## Test hint
After running `npm run setup-oauth` and completing browser auth, running `npm run fetch`
should print "✅ N tasks written to public/data/tasks.json" with no errors.
